project.description: The name of the project to add ng-mapcn to.

path.description: Directory (relative to the workspace root) where the map components are copied. Defaults to the folder saved in ng-mapcn.json, else <sourceRoot>/app/shared/components/map. No schema default, so a saved folder is never overridden.
path.x-prompt: Where should the map components be copied? (Enter: the saved folder, else <sourceRoot>/app/shared/components/map)

alias.description: Import alias for the copied components, added to tsconfig paths. Defaults to the one saved in ng-mapcn.json, else @/shared/components/map.
alias.x-prompt: Import alias for them? (Enter: the saved alias, else @/shared/components/map)

all.description: Also copy every component (except draw) instead of only the core map.

skipInstall.description: Do not install packages after copying.
